macros.name: AcroAddRow
macros.doc: Adds ⟨code⟩ to the right of \AcronymTable and ensures that \AcronymID has the correct global definition for this code.

macros.name: acrodotfill
macros.doc: This is the code that is placed between acronym description and actual page numbers.

macros.name: acroformat
macros.doc: This formats ⟨text⟩ according to ⟨type⟩ where ⟨type⟩ has either been set as property or as option from the format module.

macros.name: acroifallTF
macros.doc: Checks if all properties in the csv list ⟨properties⟩ have been set for the current acronym and either leaves ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ in the input stream.

macros.name: acroifanyTF
macros.doc: Checks if any of the properties in the csv list ⟨properties⟩ has been set for the current acronym and either leaves ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ in the input stream.

macros.name: acroifchapterTF
macros.doc: This just check if \chapter is defined.

macros.name: acroiffirstTF
macros.doc: Checks if the current usage of the current acronym is the first time and either leaves ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ in the input stream.

macros.name: acroifpagesTF
macros.doc: This is ⟨true⟩ if the option pages/display is set, and the current acronym is not single, and has at least one page number.

macros.name: acroifsingleTF
macros.doc: Checks if the current acronym is used a single time and either leaves ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ in the input stream.

macros.name: acroiftagTF
macros.doc: Checks if the current acronym has been given the tag ⟨tag⟩ and either leaves ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ in the input stream.

macros.name: acroifTF
macros.doc: Checks if the property ⟨property⟩ has been set for the current acronym and either leaves ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ in the input stream.

macros.name: acroifusedTF
macros.doc: Checks if the current acronym has been used before and either leaves ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ in the input stream.

macros.name: acrolistname
macros.doc: Expands to whatever is currently set with list/name.

macros.name: AcroNeedPackage
macros.doc: Checks if the package ⟨package⟩ is loaded and throws an error otherwise.

macros.name: acronopagerange
macros.doc: This disables page ranges.

macros.name: acronymsmap
macros.doc: Maps over the acronyms in order of appearance in the list.

macros.name: AcronymTable
macros.doc: This is an empty token list at the beginning of a list template.

macros.name: acropagefill
macros.doc: If \acroifpagesTF would be ⟨false⟩ this would do nothing. Otherwise it prints whatever is set by pages/fill.

macros.name: acropages
macros.doc: If \acroifpagesTF would be ⟨false⟩ this would do nothing. Otherwise, if pages/display is first it prints the first page number, preceded by ⟨first⟩ if pages/name is true.

macros.name: AcroPropertiesMap
macros.doc: Maps over all defined acronym properties.

macros.name: acroshow
macros.doc: For debugging puposes: writes the property ⟨property⟩ of the current acronym to the log file.

macros.name: AcroTemplateName
macros.doc: Within a template this expands to the ⟨name⟩ of the current template.

macros.name: AcroTemplateType
macros.doc: Within a template this expands to the ⟨type⟩ of the current template.

macros.name: acrotranslate
macros.doc: This command fetches the translation of ⟨key⟩ for the current language.

macros.name: acrowrite
macros.doc: Prints the property ⟨property⟩ of the current acronym.
